name: Laravel 12 Controller Creation Workflow
description: Controller creation with Form Request validation and Laravel 12 conventions

steps.content:
🎮 New Controller Created! Laravel 12 Controller Checklist:

✅ Create Form Requests: `php artisan make:request Store{{ModelName}}Request`
✅ Create Form Requests: `php artisan make:request Update{{ModelName}}Request`
✅ Use explicit return type declarations
✅ Keep controllers thin - delegate to services
✅ Use proper HTTP status codes
✅ Create API Resources if needed: `php artisan make:resource {{ModelName}}Resource`
✅ Add proper authorization with policies
✅ Use route model binding
